messages:
anya: Heads up — vault rotation in prod failed for a subset of AKV secrets after we flipped RBAC-only on tenant-B.

sam: What happened? Any error logs?

mike: I saw alerts from env-encryptor service, decrypt errors during envelope unwrap: 'Key not found' and some 403/401s from AKV.

lisa: Quick check shows some pods still used a service principal fallback that relied on legacy accessPolicies. Switching to RBAC-only removed that path.

anya: Correct — we migrated tenant-B to RBAC-only last night. I thought we updated all apps to MSI. Looks like env-encryptor on k8s still exchanges a client secret for a token (SPN).

sam: Can we roll back RBAC-only enforcement quickly? Or create a temporary access policy? What's the safest short-term fix?

mike: Options: 1) recreate an accessPolicy for the SP (fast) 2) patch env-encryptor to use ManagedIdentity/pod-identity (safer) 3) re-enable legacy access policies at tenant scope (broad, avoid).

lisa: Audit logs show the SP got 401s starting ~03:12 UTC. I can add a scoped accessPolicy for that SP to recover while we fix the service. This is config drift + rollout checklist gap.

anya: Let's do a temporary accessPolicy for recovery, but schedule a full remediation: replace SP usage with pod-managed identity, rotate KEKs, and validate prefix/KV cache behavior.

sam: For incident response: open a Jira ticket, run rotation dry-run on staging, perform AKV rewrap for the envelope KEK, and ensure rotation publishes new key_version to our metadata store.

mike: Note: the rewrap workflow requires both unwrap on the old key and wrap on the new key for the principal doing the operation. Make sure whichever identity performs the rewrap has Key permissions for UnwrapKey and WrapKey. Also add the Key operation logs (Key/UnwrapKey) to our audit filter.

lisa: I'll open the ticket and add a runbook. Quick az cli to grant an accessPolicy if needed:

```bash
az keyvault set-policy -n prod-akv -g infra-rg --spn <APP_ID> --key-permissions wrapKey unwrapKey get
```

anya: Also add an alert rule for envelope unwrap failures, e.g. query AKV diagnostic logs for 'OperationName=UnwrapKey AND ResultType=Failure'.

sam: Owners? mike -> patch env-encryptor and run staging dry-run. lisa -> temp accessPolicy and alerts. anya -> customer comms and timeline.

mike: :thumbsup: starting a quick patch, will post deploy timestamp and validate unwrap on staging. Will also audit other tenants for SP fallbacks.

devops-bot: deploybot: Started canary deploy env-encryptor@patch-202603 to staging (build 4387).

lisa: Added ticket SEC-4521, linked runbook, assigned owners and set target MTTR 3h for rollback/recovery.

anya: Post-mortem note: root cause = legacy SP fallback left in code, contributing factor = RBAC rollout checklist missing a scan for SPs using AccessPolicies.

sam: Add improvement: automation to scan AKV for non-MSI SPs referenced by accessPolicies before any RBAC-only rollout.

mike: I'll include a smoke test that validates envelope unwrap end-to-end for each tenant before we rotate KEKs.

anya: Thanks team — once staging rewrap passes, proceed with controlled rotation and notify affected customers.
